data.title: What hosts ask us.
items: Do you take a cut of food and drink?
No. Catch charges 5% of ticket sales only, never more than ₹10,000 a month. What guests spend at the bar is yours.
We have no one to run the night. Can a host do it?
Yes. List your space and we’ll introduce you to hosts as matching starts. Until then, you can invite a host you know to run a night at your venue on Catch.
Can we sell a ticket that includes food or a drink?
Yes. Set the price and say what’s included on the page. The kitchen sees the numbers before the night.
Can promoters be paid on what they bring?
Each promoter gets their own link, and Catch shows the bookings and revenue from it. How you pay them is up to you.
We have more than one outlet.
Each outlet can have its own page. Book a walkthrough and we’ll set up the team for you.
No. Guests book, pay and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.
